verdict.rationale: Working Copy documents its own automation surface through Shortcuts actions and x-callback-url, so it does offer programmatic control. Nothing in the evidence shows that this surface matches the UI: there is no action catalog and no parity statement, and many UI-driven features (hunk staging, conflict Resolve tool, commit rewriting, annotate) are described only as tap/swipe gestures. Probes found no OpenAPI spec. Missing for 10: documented coverage of UI operations through the automation API, an explicit parity guarantee, a reference listing all actions or URL commands, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Working Copy supports automation through the Shortcuts app where files and other data can flow between actions.
Use Shortcuts and x-callback-url for automation.
